overview: Blainville had 59,819 residents in the 2021 Census, a 5.2 percent increase from 2016 that outpaced the Quebec average. They live in 22,424 occupied dwellings across 54.97 square kilometres of mostly family neighbourhoods, newer districts and two industrial parks near Highway 15.

Retail and manufacturing provide the most jobs, and the city hosts several of the largest employers in its MRC. For a local business, that means a family-oriented customer base that keeps growing, local industrial clients, and competition from big-box centres along the highway corridor.
